_comment: Overlay applied with `pnpm tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json` to produce a Cria Dev.app that lives side-by-side with the release Cria.app — separate bundle ID = separate macOS data dir = separate SQLite DB + localStorage. The updater is disabled because there is no dev release channel; you rebuild from the dev branch when you want a fresh snapshot.

bundle.longDescription: Side-by-side dev build of Cria. Tracks the dev branch; not auto-updated, rebuild manually.
